changelog.text:
*   The Gemini 3 Pro Preview model has been [shut down](/docs/deprecations). The
  `gemini-3-pro-preview` now points to
  [`gemini-3.1-pro-preview`](/docs/models/gemini-3.1-pro-preview).

*     Deprecation announcement: Gemini 3 Pro Preview (`gemini-3-pro-preview`) will
  be [shut down](/docs/deprecations) March 9, 2026.

*   Launched support for the Computer Use tool in `gemini-3-pro-preview` and
  `gemini-3-flash-preview`.

*     Changed the `latest` aliases:

  *   `gemini-pro-latest` switched to `gemini-3-pro-preview`
  *   `gemini-flash-latest` switched to `gemini-3-flash-preview`

*     Launched the first Gemini 3 series model, `gemini-3-pro-preview`, our
  state-of-the-art reasoning and multimodal understanding model with powerful
  agentic and coding capabilities.

  In addition to improvements in intelligence and performance, Gemini 3 Pro
  Preview introduces new behavior around:

  *   [Media resolution](/docs/media-resolution)
  *   [Thought signatures](/docs/thinking#signatures)
  *   [Thinking levels](/docs/thinking#thinking-levels)

  Read the Gemini 3 Developer Guide for migration, new features, and specs.
